description: Run **all applicable** Raven audits for a target. Detects the surface (web page / iOS screen / React Native / code diff / video) and fans out to the right checks — contrast, tap targets, typography, layout, responsive, and taste for web; the iOS or RN set for native; parity/contract for diffs. **Use this instead of choosing individual audit_* tools.** Pass `project` to judge against bound taste.

intent.description: Optional focus such as accessibility, contrast, content, copy, or pre-ship.

nodes.description: Pre-collected snapshot data for the applicable audits.

project.description: Project identifier for taste binding and project-aware audits.

surface.description: Surface override; otherwise detected from the supplied target.

name: audit
